ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def test_detalle_softrestaurant_selecciona_periodo_por_apertura_no_cheque_fecha():
    text = DETAIL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    block = text.split('def _extract_soft(', 1)[1].split('def _mpro_operational_datetime_range', 1)[0]
    assert 'INNER JOIN turnos t WITH (NOLOCK)' in block
    assert 't.idturno = ch.idturno' in block
    assert 't.idempresa = ch.idempresa' in block
    assert 'ch.idempresa = %s' in block
    assert 't.idempresa = %s' in block
    assert 't.apertura >= %s' in block
    assert 't.apertura < %s' in block
    assert 't.cierre IS NOT NULL' in block
    assert 'WHERE ch.fecha >= %s' not in block
    assert 'cierre >= %s' not in block

def test_pagos_ticket_softrestaurant_solo_toma_turnos_cerrados_por_apertura():
    text = ENRICH.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    soft = text.split('# EXTRACCIÓN SOFTRESTAURANT', 1)[1].split('# EXTRACCIÓN MPRO', 1)[0]
